# Partner Facts: Azure / Microsoft
last-verified: 2026-01 (from training knowledge — TREAT AS STALE, verify before publish)
staleness-warning: This file was NOT web-verified. Microsoft renames aggressively
  (Copilot branding especially). The persona MUST recommend verifying current names
  before any published piece, and must not assert a name it isn't sure of.

## Agent stack (verify all before use)
- Azure AI Foundry — Microsoft's platform for building/deploying AI apps and agents
  (this absorbed/renamed earlier "Azure AI Studio"; confirm current form).
- Azure AI Agent Service — managed agent building/orchestration on Foundry.
- Semantic Kernel — open-source orchestration SDK.
- AutoGen — multi-agent framework (research lineage; check current productization).
- Copilot Studio — low-code agent/copilot builder (Power Platform lineage).
- Azure OpenAI Service — managed OpenAI models on Azure.

## Platform
- Azure Machine Learning — ML platform.
- Microsoft Foundry / Foundry Models — model catalog (verify current branding).

## Naming traps to catch in drafts
- "Copilot" is overloaded across Microsoft — M365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, GitHub Copilot
  are different things. Make sure the draft means the right one.
- "Azure AI Studio" vs "Azure AI Foundry" — confirm which is current.

## Positioning the Microsoft field team endorses
- Enterprise trust, security, compliance, identity (Entra) integration.
- Deep M365 / Teams / Power Platform integration as the differentiator.
- Responsible AI framing.
